To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the arterivirus ORF1a replication complex is composed of at least eight processing end products (nsp1 to nss8), that the SP is specific for Glu / Ser and Glu / Gly substrates, that nsp2 functions as a cofactor of the SP, and that nsp3 to nsp8 are generated by two alternative proteolytic cascades, which are mutually exclusive.

(i) the arterivirus SP has a strict specificity for Glu/ (Gly/SER) substrates, (ii) the ORF1 polyprotein can be cleaved by the SP following at least two alternative proteolytic pathways, and (iii) nsp2 is a cofactor for nsp4-mediated processing of nsp3- 8, which is essential for the major processing cascade.

the ORF2b protein of arteriviruses is cleaved by a chymo-trypsinlike serine proteases (SPs) at seven different cleavage sites, that the SPs are located in nsp4 and nsp4, and that the SPs of the arterivirus nsp2 protein are involved in the processing of the n-terminal part of the nsp2 protein.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the proteolytic processing products of the arterivirus ORF1a replicase polyprotein.
the first description of an arterivirus replicase polyprotein that can be processed by a single protease in two alternative pathways.
the proteolytic maturation of an ORF1a precursor protein, which is essential for the replication of an RNA virus.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SP is a serine protease which is activated by the nsp2 protein, and that it is this activated protease which cleaves nsp3-7 into nsp3-5 and nsp6-8.
the ORF 1a polyprotein is processed into eight end products (nsp1 to nps8), which are generated by a single chymotryp-like serine protease located in nsp4.
the SP cleaves all of its substrates with the exception of the nsp2/nsp3 site.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the arterivirus SP is a bifunctional protease that cleaves its substrates in a sequential fashion.
the ORF 1a protein can undergo alternative proteolytic processing, and the outcome of this processing is determined by the presence or absence of the nsp2 protein.
the SP is an intramolecular enzyme which can be activated by interaction with nsp2.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the arterivirus replicative cycle can be uncoupled from the proteolytic cascade by blocking the interaction between nsp2 and nsp3.

, by using a combination of sequence analysis and biochemical studies, we have identified a novel, previously unrecognized proteolytic processing pathway of a viral replicase polyprotein, which is regulated by the interaction of the polyprotein with its cofactor.
the SP is not a single, but a bifunctional protease.
